items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And I met with him that day

ctx.x: And I called him to make an appointment with him, and he said, 'Well, come on in.' And that shocked me, because he was ready, here, he invited me in. I didn't think it would happen at a major hotel, that major hotel, the Hilton. But it was because of the man, you see, the entertainment director.

And I met with him that day and when I...By that time, when I got to him -- and he was a nice man -- and we started talking. I exploded. I was unloading, because I had somebody listening, and I didn't have good tactics. He said, 'Wait, wait a minute, Monk. Don't...Wait, don't get excited.'
